subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v3 06/11] mountd: bound the junction path before copying it into e_path

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch fixes a potential heap corruption issue in the mountd service by bounding the junction path before copying it into e_path. The problem arises when a junction path exceeds NFS_MAXPATHLEN bytes, causing the strcpy function to write beyond the bounds of the fixed-size buffer. To prevent this, the patch checks the length of the junction path and rejects it if it's too long, returning NULL instead.
